title: 8-bit shift register

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54165, SN54LS165, SN74165, SN74LS165 Parallel-load 8-bit shift registers, bulletin DL-S 7611375 (October 1976)

pins.name: SHIFT/LOAD
pins.text: low loads A..H into the register directly, independent of clock, clock inhibit and serial input; high allows shifting

pins.name: CLOCK
pins.text: NORed with CLOCK INHIBIT; either may be used as the clock

pins.name: CLOCK INHIBIT
pins.text: high inhibits clocking; change it to high only while CLOCK is high

state.changesOn: rising edge of (CLOCK OR CLOCK INHIBIT) while SHIFT/LOAD is high
rules: SHIFT/LOAD low: QA..QH = A..H at once (direct overriding load)
SHIFT/LOAD high, CLOCK INHIBIT low, CLOCK low: hold
SHIFT/LOAD high, CLOCK INHIBIT low, rising CLOCK edge: QA = SERIAL INPUT, QB..QH = QA..QG before the edge (shift toward QH)
SHIFT/LOAD high, CLOCK INHIBIT high: hold
The clock is a 2-input NOR of CLOCK and CLOCK INHIBIT; holding either high inhibits clocking, holding either low lets the other be the clock

electrical.notes: SHIFT/LOAD is a double load: IIL -3.2 mA, IIH 80 uA.
